selection: Every record with manually corrected qrsc annotations in the release manifest; fixed before analysis, no fit/evaluation split because no parameters are fitted
policy: Non-overlapping 60-second windows aligned to each AF episode onset, fully contained in manually labelled AF. Do not cross rhythm transitions or fill missing intervals. Include every positive finite RR; no physiologic outlier trimming.
limitations: Only two records have manually corrected beats: not a population calibration.
Corrected beats do not distinguish ectopy; RR is not necessarily NN.
No signal morphology or f-wave amplitude validation from beat annotations.
Short AF episodes are reported but excluded from full-window summaries.
